svg.text: 6 header fields, 5 editable stage columns and 8 lanes

g.text: Free to use and adapt. uiuxdesignservices.us
Free to use and adapt. uiuxdesignservices.us
PART AND WHAT GOES IN IT
Name and role, scenario and goal, expectations,
research base (methods, sessions, dates), map owner,
5 columns, renamed from research; add up to 7
What the person does at each stage
Screens, emails, calls and people they meet
Verbatim quote with a participant ID
Emotion curve, one point per stage from -2 to +2
What breaks, slows or worries them
Source and evidence level: H heard, O observed, M
What the team will change at that stage
One named owner and one number per opportunity
